items.description: This chapter covers topics related to building custom visuals and other ways to develop with Power BI. You can also check visuals developed by Akvelon and by Microsoft, which are open-source and serve as good samples of how to implement a custom visual.

items.title: Development

children.title: Visuals Tools
children.description: Tools for building/packaging Power BI visuals. Every Power BI custom visuals developer uses these tools.

repo_info.description: Contains tools for building/packaging Power BI visuals

children.title: Gantt Chart
children.description: A Gantt chart is a type of bar chart which illustrates a project timeline or schedule.

repo_info.description: A Gantt chart is a type of bar chart which illustrates a project timeline or schedule. The Gantt Chart visual shows the Tasks, Start Dates, Durations, % Complete, and Resources for a project. The Gantt Chart visual can be used to show current schedule status using percent-complete shadings and a vertical "TODAY" line. The Legend may be used to group or filter tasks based upon data values.

children.title: Sample Bar Chart
children.description: A sample bar chart visual, used for tutorial purposes.

repo_info.description: Bar Chart Custom Visual for tutorial.

children.title: Chiclet Slicer
children.description: Use this slicer to display image and/or text buttons that act as an in-canvas filter. Define additional properties for the layout & selection to customize this slicer to meet your specific needs.

repo_info.description: Repo for Power BI Chiclet Slicer custom visual

children.title: Sankey
children.description: Type of flow diagram in which the width of the series is in proportion to the quantity of the flow. Use it to find major contributions to an overall flow.

repo_info.description: Sankey is a type of flow diagram in which the width of the series is in proportion to the quantity of the flow. Use it to find major contributions to an overall flow.

children.title: Force Graph
children.description: Allows to visualize the relationship between items, the weightage of the relationship and the flow often brings out the untold insights into limelight, which are otherwise not very evident.

repo_info.description: Repo for Power BI Force Graph custom visual

children.title: Timeline
children.description: Graphical date range selector used as a filtering component in the report canvas.

repo_info.description: Timeline slicer is a graphical date range selector used as a filtering component in the report canvas

children.title: Word Cloud
children.description: Word Cloud is a visual representation of word frequency and value. Use it to get instant insight into the most important terms in a set.

repo_info.description: Repo for Power BI Word Cloud custom visual

children.title: Tornado
children.description: A bar chart with category values listed vertically. Use for comparing the relative importance of a variable between two distinct groups.

repo_info.description: Repo for Power BI Tornado custom visual

children.title: Sunburst
children.description: Sunburst is a multilevel donut chart, used to visualize hierarchical data, depicted by concentric circles.

repo_info.description: Sunburst is a multilevel donut chart, used to visualize hierarchical data, depicted by concentric circles.

children.title: Webpack plugin
children.description: The plugin allows for developing custom visuals by using webpack to build a visual package.

repo_info.description: powerbi-visuals-webpack-plugin

children.title: Sample Slicer
children.description: A sample slicer visual for tutorials, demonstrating the use of the Advanced Filtering API introduced in the version 1.7 of PowerBI Visuals Tools.

repo_info.description: Demonstrates creating a powerbi slicer visual using various powerbi filtering APIs and features.

children.title: Radar
children.description: A simple radar chart supporting multiple measures plotted over a categorical axis. Also known as a web chart, spider chart, or star chart. Use to display performance metrics for quality improvement.

repo_info.description: Repo for Power BI Radar Chart custom visual

children.title: Heatmap
children.description: Use this custom visual to build a table heat map that can be used to visualise and compare data values in an easy and intuitive way.

repo_info.description: powerbi-visuals-heatmap

children.title: Chord Diagram
children.description: A chord diagram is a graphical method of displaying the interrelationships between data in a matrix.

repo_info.description: A chord diagram is a graphical method of displaying the inter-relationships between data in a matrix.

children.title: Choropleth
children.description: Displays a hierarchical map set with each location filled in a color from specified values.

repo_info.description: powerbi-visuals-drilldown-choropleth

children.title: Histogram
children.description: A histogram chart plots data ranges into intervals. Useful for estimating density.

repo_info.description: A histogram chart plots data ranges into intervals. Useful for estimating density.

children.title: Mekko Chart
children.description: A mix of a 100% stacked column chart and a 100% stacked bar chart combined into one view. Similar to a treemap, the dimensional values are represented by length and width of each rectangle. The width of a column is proportional to the total value of the column.

repo_info.description: A Mekko chart is a mix of a 100% stacked column chart and a 100% stacked bar chart combined into one view. Similar to a treemap, the dimensional values are represented by length and width of each rectangle. The width of a column is proportional to the total value of the column.

children.title: Pulse Chart
children.description: Pulse chart shows a line chart annotated with key events. Each event can be selected to filter and cross highlight other visuals to reveal insights or help tell a story.

repo_info.description: Pulse chart shows a line chart annotated with key events. Each events can be selected to filter and cross highlight other visuals to reveal insights or help tell a story. Pulse chart supports animation so you can load your report and watch it play through key events, without user interaction. This visualization is perfect for story telling with data, especially the Power BI publish to web feature. Use it anywhere you need to draw attention to events that shaped a trend.

children.title: Bullet Chart
children.description: A bullet chart that includes four orientations and a few customization options. Use to feature a single measure against a qualitative range.

repo_info.description: A bullet chart that includes four orientations and a few customization options. Use to feature a single measure against a qualitative range.

children.title: Enhanced Scatter
children.description: A few more properties were added to the existing scatter chart visual, including shapes as markers, background image support, and developer crosshairs for positioning elements onto an image background.

repo_info.description: A few more properties were added to the existing scatter chart visual, including shapes as markers, background image support, and developer crosshairs for positioning elements onto an image background.

children.title: Dual KPI
children.description: A visual for displaying two correlated KPIs within a single visual.

repo_info.description: A visual for displaying two correlated KPIs within a single visual.

children.title: Aster
children.description: An Aster plot is a twist on a standard donut chart, using a second value to drive sweep angle.

repo_info.description: Repo for Power BI Aster Plot custom visual

children.title: Dotplot
children.description: A dot plot is used to show a representation of the distribution of frequencies. It is most often used to show counts of an occurrence.

repo_info.description: A dot plot is used to show a representation of the distribution of frequencies. It is most often used to show counts of an occurrence.

children.title: Globe Map
children.description: A 3D visual using WebGL for plotting locations, with category values displayed as bar heights and heat maps.

repo_info.description: A 3D visual using WebGL for plotting locations, with category values displayed as bar heights and heat maps. Shift+Click on bar to change center point. Slicing data points will animate to average location.

children.title: Stream Graph
children.description: A stacked area chart with smooth interpolation. Often used to display values over time.

repo_info.description: A stacked area chart with smooth interpolation. Often used to display values over time.

children.title: Line Dot Chart
children.description: The LineDot chart is an animated line chart with fun animated dots. Use the LineDot chart to engage your audience especially in a presentation context.

repo_info.description: The LineDot chart is an animated line chart with fun animated dots. Use the LineDot chart to engage your audience especially in a presentation context. The bubbles size can be dynamic based on data you provide. A counter is provided that you can use to show a running value as the chart animates. Format options are provided for Lines, Dots, and Animation.

children.title: Funnel
children.description: Find outliers in your data, using a funnel plot.

repo_info.description: Find outliers in your data, using a funnel plot

children.title: Drilldown Player
children.description: Animates report components like a slicer on autopilot.

repo_info.description: powerbi-visuals-drilldown-player

children.title: Cartogram
children.description: Displays a hierarchical map set as a circle for each location, with size/color from specified values.

repo_info.description: powerbi-visuals-drilldown-cartogram
